name: Rieger
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Rieger in Mittenwald – Your Alpine Adventure Awaits!** Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, **Mittenwald** is where breathtaking nature meets authentic Bavarian charm. At **Rieger**, we invite you to experience the magic of the mountains in a cozy, family-run atmosphere. ### **A Home Away from Home** Our traditional guesthouse combines rustic warmth with modern comfort. Whether you're seeking relaxation after a day of hiking or a hearty meal to fuel your next expedition, **Rieger** is your perfect retreat. ### **Culinary Delights** Indulge in regional specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Obatzda**, and fresh **Tiroler Gröstl**—all crafted with local ingredients. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Bier** or a warming **Glühwein** by the fireplace. ### **Adventure at Your Doorstep** From the **Karwendel** peaks to the serene **Isar** River, **Mittenwald** is a playground for outdoor enthusiasts. Whether you're skiing in winter or hiking in summer, the possibilities are endless. ### **Why Choose Rieger?** ✔ **Central location** – Just steps from **Mittenwald’s** main square and train station. ✔ **Authentic hospitality** – A welcoming family-run experience. ✔ **Unbeatable views** – Panoramic vistas of the **Tirol** Alps from your window. **Plan your escape to the Alps today—where every stay feels like coming home.** --- *[Your HTML tags remain unchanged, e.g., `
